notes: Found and fixed a real gap in the self-update installer itself: copyIntoApp() called File::copy() but never checked whether it actually succeeded, so a single file silently failing to overwrite (a lock, a permissions quirk, anything transient) left the app running a mix of old and new code with the install still reporting full success and no way to tell which file was stale. Now a failed copy aborts the install with a clear error naming exactly which file(s) failed, instead of pretending everything updated.
